_source: https://studentaccount.utoronto.ca/fees-payments/tuition-fee-schedules/ — U of T publishes a separate international fee schedule PDF per faculty. Figures read from the 2025-26 Fall-Winter INTERNATIONAL schedules, the latest published.
_basis: Each figure is the full-time PROGRAM fee for the Fall-Winter session, the flat rate charged to a full-time international student. Mandatory incidental fees and UHIP are charged on top and are recorded separately.

_excluded.UTM: Its schedule gives two full-time programme rates (C$65,740 and C$72,260) and every row is labelled for the cohort admitted in 2023 or earlier. Which rate a new applicant pays cannot be read off the PDF, so UTM-only programmes are left unpriced.
_excluded.UTSC: Its schedule bills per credit by semester (C$6,357.00 per 0.5 credit) and states no annual programme fee. Multiplying it out would be our arithmetic, not UTSC's published figure, so UTSC-only programmes are left unpriced.
_excluded.Dentistry: Layout differs; the four columns did not align on extraction and the numbers were not trusted.
_excluded.CHRM: Certificate in Human Resource Management, not a degree programme.
